title: The Control Panel
briefing: Power's on! Now the control panel needs setting up. It stores the factory's settings in variables: labelled boxes that remember values. It also needs to greet whoever's working the shift. Get it wrong and the panel forgets everything!
hints: Make a variable with name = value, e.g. machines = 3. Text goes in quotes, numbers don't, and True/False have capital letters.
len(factory_name) counts the letters in factory_name. input() gives you back whatever the operator typed, so save it: operator = input("Your name: ").
factory_name = "ByteWorks", machines = 3, power_kw = 12.5, is_open = True, name_length = len(factory_name), operator = input("Your name: ") then print("Welcome,", operator)
bonus: Use int() to turn the string "42" into a number, add 8 to it and print the result. What happens if you try "42" + 8 instead?
